s: December 9, 2021 - The opposite to buying on credit is buying for cash, or buying something outright. This is the case for all purchases that don’t require a loan, but it is mainly used when talking about large purchases such as real estate and cars, to show that you have the money ready and don’t require a mortgage or any other financial assistance. ... Unlike “acheter comptant”, it isn’t used to express that you have the resources to pay for something, instead it is more literal.
